portraits.name: 孙武
portraits.prompt:
Create a single finished NPC portrait asset for the Chinese historical browser game 春秋·列国志. Requested output resolution: exactly 512 x 512 pixels, square 1:1.
Reference image role: STYLE / MATERIAL / PALETTE / COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY. It depicts Confucius. Replace that person with the specified DISTINCT character; do NOT reuse the reference face, age, beard or headwear indiscriminately. Preserve the cohesive art direction: warm ivory aged xuan-paper ground, restrained sepia and charcoal ink-wash, delicate naturalistic hand-painted facial modeling, subtle paper grain, dry-brush robe edges, quiet diffuse ink behind shoulders, softly lit readable eyes and face. Premium semi-realistic historical game illustration; no photorealistic camera effect, no anime, no 3D.
Composition: one chest-up figure, face dominant and centered in upper-middle, whole hair/headwear visible with top clearance, broad readable shoulder silhouette. Same visual scale as reference; suitable for thumbnails and 512 portrait dialogs. Muted warm skin and historical clothing, gentle three-quarter view. Plain pale parchment background. Distinguish the person through facial structure, age, expression, headwear and clothing, not scenery.
Eastern Zhou / Spring and Autumn inspired clothing; imagined artistic character design, no claim of literal likeness. Avoid later winged official hats, Qing robes, modern clothes, fantasy jewelry, oversized armor, props held near face, elaborate scenery.
No text, calligraphy, seals, signatures, watermark, frames, borders, UI, multiple views or contact sheet. One character only. Final deliverable one 512 x 512 square portrait.
Character specification:
Sun Wu (Sun Tzu), 吴之将军. A lean Chinese military strategist around 42, angular face, high cheekbones, sharp focused eyes, straight firm brows, short restrained black moustache and neat short pointed beard; disciplined, reserved, observant, no smile. Hair tied under a simple dark low-profile cloth military cap, a charcoal-brown robe with understated Eastern Zhou leather/lamellar shoulder protection and muted dark reddish-brown collar. A scholar-general, no helmet covering face, no weapons. Face visibly different from Confucius, younger and leaner.

portraits.name: 管仲
portraits.prompt:
Create one square 512 x 512 NPC portrait of Guan Zhong (管仲), chief minister of Qi, for 春秋·列国志. Use the final approved guan_zhong-512.png as identity and style reference when supplied.
Character: vigorous mature Chinese man about 50, broad square face, low broad forehead, substantial cheeks, heavy square jaw, broad blunt nose, deep-set narrow eyes and thick straight brows. Preserve the astute, practical, quietly authoritative expression. Short close-cropped dark beard and separate short dense moustache, a few gray temple hairs; never a flowing Confucius-like long beard.
Attire: dignified high-ranking Eastern Zhou minister attending court. A structured compact dark crown around the topknot, secured by a simple horizontal pin, with thin dark crown ties. Fine matte deep charcoal silk cross-collar court robe, smooth broad shoulders and controlled folds. Crisp ivory inner collar; restrained dark cinnabar-red woven edging with subtle antique-ochre angular geometric motifs. Expensive and sober, no rough travel shawl or utilitarian shoulder clasp. This is a conservative historical-game interpretation, not an exact reconstruction of Guan Zhong's personal clothing.
Composition and style: single chest-up portrait, face large and readable at thumbnail size, complete crown within the frame with top clearance. Warm aged xuan-paper ground, faint diffuse gray ink wash, fine semi-realistic hand-painted facial shading, charcoal and warm earth palette, dry-brush edges at lower shoulders. Match the portrait set's restrained ink-and-paper aesthetic.
No text, seal, signature, watermark, border, UI, hands or props. No Ming/Qing side-wing official hat, crane rank badge, imperial dragon robe, beaded imperial crown, armor, flashy jewelry, modern clothing, fantasy effects, anime or plastic 3D. Target delivery PNG 512 x 512; verify actual tool output and resize if required.

portraits.name: 西施
portraits.prompt:
Edit the supplied portrait of Xi Shi (西施) for the Chinese historical game 春秋·列国志. Upgrade ONLY her clothing and hair ornaments from plain everyday linen to refined, luxurious but tasteful Eastern Zhou / Wu-Yue court-inspired dress. This is an imagined artistic design, not a claim of exact archaeological reconstruction.
EDIT TARGET: xi_shi-512.png.
IDENTITY INVARIANTS: keep this exact adult woman's face, age approximately 23, graceful oval facial structure, straight delicate eyebrows, dark almond eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, calm reflective slightly wistful expression, gaze direction, head angle and pose. Preserve the dark hair color, overall pinned-up hair silhouette, chest-up framing and the existing hand-painted semi-realistic ink-and-paper style. Do not redesign her face, make the eyes bigger, add modern makeup, or change her into another person.
COSTUME UPGRADE:
Replace ALL coarse, worn gray-green homespun fabric and plain brown lapels with finely woven matte silk. The outer cross-collar robe is a beautiful muted CELADON / gray-jade green with gentle lustrous folds, smooth shoulder planes and delicate tone-on-tone small angular cloud and curving water-inspired woven motifs. An overlapping inner collar in pale warm ivory with a second thin layer of DUSTY LOTUS-PINK silk. A narrow, elegant ANTIQUE GOLD and deep-teal patterned woven border follows the crossed lapels and shoulder/sleeve edge, fine repeated abstract geometric ornament rather than giant pictorial motifs. Keep gold accents small and softly aged, never glossy yellow metal. Introduce clear layered collar construction and carefully dressed folds so the garment looks costly and intentionally styled at portrait scale.
The chest and shoulders remain fully covered with modest traditional cross-collar construction. Broad sleeve shapes and subtle silken drape imply high-status clothing; elegance through textile quality, harmony and detail, not exposed skin. Remove the muddy patchwork / distressed cloak appearance entirely.
HAIR ORNAMENT UPGRADE:
Retain her recognizably pinned-up dark hairstyle but groom it with a few more deliberate neat strands. Replace the bare wooden stick with TWO delicate pale celadon-jade hairpins with tiny restrained antique-gold fittings, one with a small carved abstract curl or leaflike tip. Add a tiny understated jade ornament nestled in the bun, not a giant crown. One very small jade drop near the visible ear is acceptable if naturally readable. Avoid large pearl clusters, floating jewelry, hanging tassels over face, empress phoenix crowns, Ming/Qing hairpieces, modern tiaras and oversized flowers. Ornaments must read clearly at 512px without crowding face.
OVERALL: Xi Shi as a famously beautiful, refined young woman dressed for court, with graceful dignity and a slightly wistful air. The fine silk, elegant jade and quiet gold give a noticeable upgrade over the rustic original, while her facial identity and restrained character remain unchanged.
PALETTE / STYLE INVARIANTS: warm ivory aged xuan-paper background, faint soft gray ink wash, restrained sepia facial brushwork, natural warm skin, dry-brush feathering at lower shoulder edges. Celadon, dusty lotus-pink and antique gold are muted complementary accents, not bright fantasy colors. Match the existing portrait set. Soft diffuse lighting, crisp expressive eyes, no glossy plastic or photography.
One square 512 x 512 chest-up portrait. Keep the entire hair ornament and bun inside the frame with margin. No text, calligraphy, seal, signature, watermark, border or UI. No additional people, scenery, props, hands, visible cleavage, bare shoulders, armor, imperial dragon robes, oversized jewelry, anime, chibi, 3D or magic effects.
